questions.text: The manager of a firm is entitled to a commission of 10% of the net profit AFTER charging such commission. Net profit before commission is Rs. 16,500. The commission is:
questions.explanation: commission = 16500 x 10/(100+10) = Rs. 1,500  Correct option A. Distractors: B = used the before-charging formula; C = subtracted the rate in the denominator (100 - rate); D = used a wrong denominator (100 + 2*rate).

questions.text: A firm's works manager earns 10% commission on profit remaining after the commission itself. Profit before commission is Rs. 44,000. The commission is:
questions.explanation: commission = 44000 x 10/(100+10) = Rs. 4,000  Correct option D. Distractors: A = used a wrong denominator (100 + 2*rate); B = used the before-charging formula; C = subtracted the rate in the denominator (100 - rate).
